requirements.spec: All three message strings in src/errors.js must be in Chinese
requirements.expected_artifact: src/errors.js with Chinese strings for E_NOT_FOUND, E_FORBIDDEN, E_TIMEOUT
requirements.evidence: All three keys have Chinese values: E_NOT_FOUND='未找到请求的记录。', E_FORBIDDEN='您没有执行此操作的权限。', E_TIMEOUT='操作超时，请稍后重试。'

requirements.spec: The table in docs/errors.md must show the same new Chinese messages (not the old English ones)
requirements.expected_artifact: docs/errors.md with Chinese messages matching src/errors.js
requirements.evidence: Table shows all three codes with matching Chinese messages: E_NOT_FOUND='未找到请求的记录。', E_FORBIDDEN='您没有执行此操作的权限。', E_TIMEOUT='操作超时，请稍后重试。'. No English messages present.

requirements.spec: A CHANGELOG.md must exist at the repo root with an entry recording this localization change
requirements.expected_artifact: CHANGELOG.md at repo root with entry about zh-CN localization
requirements.evidence: CHANGELOG.md exists with entry: 'Localized error catalog to Simplified Chinese (zh-CN): updated all three message strings in src/errors.js and the corresponding table in docs/errors.md.'
